All 27 overview/category/phase/status routes fit 320px and use real dedicated pages.
All authored interactive controls use registered Material Web components; standard document hyperlinks remain semantic links.

scope: Observed static-site publication, generated-file byte comparison, GitHub Pages configuration, and public-origin Chromium checks only. Does not establish Windows/native application acceptance or backend behavior beyond the documented browser surfaces.
